thread:
Maya (CS): starting enablement thread for HarborWind pre-cutover dry run. scope: network connectivity, deploy role perms, KMS BYOK handover, and audit log ingestion. target cutover: 2026-03-25. calling out renewal sensitivity — theyre evaluating reserved capacity and want clean handoff.
Tom (HarborWind): thanks. engineering available next week for a 2-hour dry run window. we prefer shared ENIs for now, but throughput target is 1.5k qps at 256 tokens.
Dylan (SE): noted on qps. we'll size ENI pool accordingly; shared ENIs ok. Dylan action: prepare load profile and test harness.
Ibrahim (Network): network checklist: TGW attachment, route propagation, prefix-list exceptions, and a firewall egress hop. I need HarborWind firewall peer IPs and allowed ports (TCP 443 + ephemeral).
Tom (HarborWind): sending peer IPs and ports to DM. also they require traffic to be NAT'd through a centralized egress appliance for inspection.
Priya (Security): KMS BYOK questions: does HarborWind want Redwood to perform GenerateDataKey on their CMK, or will they pre-sign keys? also confirm whether grant-based access is acceptable.
Tom (HarborWind): prefer grants. they will create the key in their account and grant our ingest role access. key rotation annually, HSM-backed preferred.
Priya (Security): ok, we'll prepare a grants-based flow. sample grant command we'll need them to run (PUT to KMS):
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/harborwind-byok --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Ingest --operations "Decrypt" "GenerateDataKey"
```
Priya (Security): also need the S3 bucket ARN and lifecycle rules. recommended lifecycle: move to GLACIER after 90d, delete after 2 years. object-lock must be off for our ingestion.
Maya (CS): adding note: HarborWind is in a 90-day reserved trial. if dry run slips beyond cutover window, renewal risk escalates to high. logging as "at-risk" in the playbook until cutover completes.
Dylan (SE): IAM trust: we'll require HarborWind to create two roles: HarborWind-Redwood-Deploy (assume by our deploy principal) and HarborWind-LogViewer (assume by their security). request: set max session duration to 4h and accept tags for job_id/env. sample trust policy I'll paste in the onboarding doc.
Ibrahim (Network): quick snag: their TGW has an AWS-managed prefix list that blocks 172.20.0.0/16. HarborWind infra must add our region CIDR 172.20.0.0/16 to allowlist or we won't route. Tom can you nudge infra?
Tom (HarborWind): already raised with infra; theyre on it and expect change in 2 hours.
ops-bot: scheduled run 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z - dry-run window reserved (2h).
Dylan (SE): pre-dry-run acceptance criteria proposal: 1) ENIs provisioned, 2) KMS grant applied and tested, 3) S3 put-object allowed from Redwood-Ingest role, 4) end-to-end generation latency under SLA (p95 < 250ms) for baseline profile. agree?
Priya (Security): add: successful decrypt and generate-data-key call results, and IAM session tag validation.
Maya (CS): agreed. I'll log these as gating tasks. also capturing feedback loop: HarborWind wants a single Slack thread for post-run action items + a short retrospective doc.
Dylan (SE): I'll run a pre-check script against staging; attaching command sample:
```bash
AWS_PROFILE=redwood-ingest aws s3api put-object --bucket harborwind-audit --key smoke/test --body /dev/null || echo "put failed"
```
Dylan (SE): note: disable object-lock on bucket or test will fail.
Tom (HarborWind): infra updated prefix-list and KMS team confirmed grant process. I'll drop the bucket ARN and role ARNs in this thread in 15m.
Priya (Security): once we have bucket ARN, I'll draft the exact bucket policy to permit PutObject and ListBucket for our ingest role and include s3:PutObjectAcl for correct ownership.
Maya (CS): action roundup: Maya - update playbook + renewal flag (today). Dylan - test harness + pre-check (tomorrow 11:00 PST). Ibrahim - TGW routing verification (today EOD). Priya - KMS grant checklist + bucket policy draft (tomorrow EOD). Tom - provide ARNs and confirm infra changes (in 15m).
Tom (HarborWind): acked.
Maya (CS): next sync: 09:00 PST day before cutover. react with :white_check_mark: when you ack your items.
Dylan (SE): :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (Network): :white_check_mark:
Priya (Security): :white_check_mark:
Tom (HarborWind): :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS): closing for now, will post updated playbook and attach the dry-run retrospective doc after the window. thanks everyone.
